name: fresh-session-handoff-evolution
note: Each stage runs in a fresh session over the retained product only. The baseline arm uses the same task without OW.

stages.prompt: Work only in the assigned temporary product directory. Use OW for this substantive task; implementation and final acceptance are explicitly delegated for this increment. Build dependency-free Python rules.py with quote(process_cash, input_basis, quality, freight, skills), importable without effects, returning a dict with cash, quality and freight integer values. Inputs are nonnegative integers. Skills are distinct known names, at most three; invalid selections raise ValueError. With no skills, cash is process_cash + input_basis, quality and freight unchanged. Organic bonuses are +50% process cash, +100% quality and +50% freight. Apply bonuses additively against each original base; never modify input_basis. Round each modified component once, half-up, to an integer before adding input_basis. Deliver only organic now. The owner has ALSO APPROVED a later efficiency skill: -20% process cash, +10% quality, -10% freight, compatible with organic. Efficiency is not playable in this increment; preserve its exact approved rules for future work. Keep outcomes/important constraints durable, retain meaningful independent tests, verify and leave no completed organic plan behind. Save a concise response outside the product. Do not copy the conversation or completed plan into durable docs. The next session will have only the retained product, not this prompt or response.
